title: VPAT readiness: audit & remediate button/table/chart tokens, keyboard nav, and contrast
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Goal: Bring key UI surface areas (buttons, data tables, dense charts) to VPAT-ready conformance for WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and document mitigations for known gaps. This ticket covers: (1) token review and contrast fixes for critical action and data states, (2) keyboard navigation and focus order for complex tables and chart legends, (3) ARIA role/attribute remediation for interactive elements and data visualizations, and (4) producing a VPAT guidance doc + audit artifacts for Legal/Compliance. Scope excludes full component redesigns; we will provide tactical fixes and recommended follow-ups where redesign is required.
acceptance_criteria: Contrast: All primary/secondary/critical button states and table row/column highlights pass 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text per axe-core automated checks and manual spot checks.

Keyboard: Tables allow row-level focus, sortable headers are reachable by keyboard and announce sort state to screen readers, chart legends and interactive points are tabbable with clear focus styles.
ARIA: Buttons, toggles, and chart controls have semantic roles and accessible names; data tables include proper row/column headers and aria-describedby for complex cells.
VPAT artifacts: An audit spreadsheet with test results, a confluence-ready VPAT draft, and links to remediation PRs are delivered and reviewed by Compliance and Engineering.
Regression coverage: Storybook examples updated with a11y tests (jest-axe or axe-playwright) for modified components.
Design sign-off: UX accessibility review completed and design tokens updated in Figma + token JSON exported for engineering.
Updated release notes mentioning accessibility improvements and any behavioral changes for downstream teams.
tasks: Run automated axe-core sweep across components in Storybook and capture failing rules (task owner: Aisha).
Audit color tokens: identify token names used by buttons/tables/charts and propose contrast adjustments (owner: Maya).
Implement focus-ring tokens and ensure they do not rely solely on outline:none (owner: Eng - ENG-6842).
Table keyboard behavior: add roving tabIndex for table rows and ensure header sorting is operable via Space/Enter (owner: ENG-7051).
Chart semantics: attach aria-label/aria-describedby to SVG charts, ensure legends are keyboard focusable and announce state (owner: Eng/Design pair).
Update Storybook examples to include keyboard interaction stories and a11y snapshots (owner: Aisha).
Create VPAT draft and audit spreadsheet with pass/fail + remediation notes (owner: Maya).
Open GitHub PRs linking to design tokens JSON and include code-level notes for engineers (owner: ENG-6842).
Schedule compliance review with Legal (due by 2026-03-24) and incorporate feedback (owner: Maya).
